rationale: Search systematically for conditional continuation/reversal of market-structure events, not a single fixed signal: six independently interpretable mechanisms and four observable trend-volatility regimes on native closed H1 bars, across original full 12-asset HXC1 universe. Training-only selection and explicit abstinence; no exact closed-study rerun.

dataHandling.barSource: original H1, all times UTC, timestamp equals END of fully completed H1 candle
dataHandling.clockSafety: signal t only completed bars <=t; entry proxy next H1 bar opening t; exit close at t+h hours (h 1 or 4), all holding H1 bars contiguous or label unknown
dataHandling.featureLookback: last 49 observed H1 bars, with at least 24 strictly contiguous 1h returns for realized sigma; gaps not filled
dataHandling.M15: shorter 13-week coverage inspected only for optional intrahour path validation, never trained into year-long H1 policy
dataHandling.M1: last four weeks not used for tuning or confirmation

regime: 4 states from ex-ante 8/32 bar true-range ratio >1.3 and abs(last12 log return)>1.25*sqrt(12)*sigma24; all native cBot OHLCV available
counterfactualPopulation: Every valid candidate family/regime/horizon/symbol event before future label; known and unknown labels disclosed; fixed directional family sign never retrospectively inverted

selection.method: Train 26w only: globally pooled across four FX symbols, per family-regime-horizon mean optimistic EUR commission-floor and matched 4-bar momentum increment; positive in both train halves; n>=60 and >=8 distinct train weeks; lower z3.30 SE >0 versus cash and momentum (48 familywise conditional tests). No per-symbol tuning. On selection and exposed audit report every candidate subgroup shadow, but only train-qualified groups can produce shadow admission. At same clock and symbol choose one pre-registered highest train conservative EUR lower-bound, deterministic tie break, no trade orders.

benchmark: matched prior-four-closed-bar momentum direction and equal holding

finance.conversion: USD-quoted FX 1000 units*(exit-entry)USD converted at same-time original closed H1 EURUSD; USDJPY JPY quote divided by USDJPY and EURUSD at exit proxy
finance.missingExecution: historical entry/exit BID-ASK, slippage, financing and real conversion unobserved; commission-only optimistic EUR proxy, no full NET or funded cBot claim

scopes.evaluation: last 4 weeks of exposed phase only

additionalHistoricalPath.riskOutput: original future contiguous lower/high excursion relative to subsequent H1 open price proxy; report adverse/favorable bps for labelled signal and coverage; never funded DD, no stop fitting
additionalHistoricalPath.missing: A missing quarter-hour/minute in original history makes excursion path UNKNOWN. No fill or interpolation.
additionalHistoricalPath.qualification: risk descriptive only, historically exposed, does not provide spread-inclusive NET, funded risk or independent confirmation
